title: Big Iron meets Stealth ⚡ MSFS 2020 PC Marketplace Update – A‑400M Atlas & FB‑22
description:
MSFS Marketplace Update Feb 28: iniBuilds A-400M Atlas & FB-22 Strike Raptor (MSFS PC). This Microsoft Flight Simulator Marketplace Update features the new A-400M Atlas and FB-22 Strike Raptor.

Today’s MSFS Marketplace Update (February 28, 2026) brings two massive additions to Microsoft Flight Simulator for PC. Whether you want the heavy-lift capabilities of the iniBuilds A-400M Atlas or the stealth speed of the FB-22 Strike Raptor, this MSFS PC Update has you covered.

✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)
The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 Microsoft / iniBuilds: A‑400M Atlas (A highly detailed modern military transport with impressive scale and presence)
🛫 Rodrigo Moraes: FB‑22 Strike Raptor (A futuristic stealth strike aircraft inspired by next‑gen combat concepts)
